subject: Novamed renewal & onboarding: procurement kickoff for capacity increase
messages:
From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@novamed.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novamed renewal + vendor onboarding for capacity expansion

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — our renewal window for Novamed is coming up in October and we’re planning a capacity increase across several workloads. Before we route anything through procurement, procurement has asked for an updated vendor onboarding package and a clear path for the PO (we use SAP via our procurement portal).

Key asks from our side: 
- Can you share the latest SOW with term options for a 12 vs 24 month commitment and an uplift pricing table for the proposed capacity increase?
- We need your vendor onboarding matrix (tax forms, SOC 2, contact list, invoice remit) so procurement can start the vendor master creation.
- Any preferences on purchase order split (monthly vs quarterly) and billing contact at Redwood?

Would it be possible to get the docs this week? Procurement is targeting a kickoff meeting the week of Aug 28 to get the portal ticket raised.

Thanks — cc'ing procurement so they have visibility.

Best,
Samantha Holt
Director, Cloud Ops
Novamed

Attachments: (none in this message; will accept file uploads to the vendor portal)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@novamed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2029 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed renewal + vendor onboarding for capacity expansion

Thanks Samantha — glad to hear from you.

I’ve attached our current SOW (redwood_sow_v2.pdf) and a vendor_onboard_matrix.xlsx template that outlines the procurement fields Novamed typically needs. High-level next steps: 

1) Please fill the onboarding matrix with your ERP vendor code (if available), remit address, and preferred PO cadence.
2) Procurement should open a portal ticket and attach the completed matrix plus the vendor tax form (we can accept a scanned W-9 or equivalent).
3) We’ll propose the mutual action plan below and confirm a kickoff time: 
   - Target: Kickoff meeting (portal handoff + vendor master creation) — Tue, Aug 29 or Wed, Aug 30 (we’re flexible).
   - Deliverable: Completed onboarding matrix + tax form from Novamed by Aug 27.
   - Deliverable: Redwood to provide final SOW and pricing table with 12/24 month options by Aug 24.

Notes/requirements: 
- Procurement will need our SOC 2 Type II attestation link (https://drive.google.com/.../soc2-2028) and a Redwood contact for invoice remediation (billing@redwood.com).
- For larger capacity increases we recommend staging the PO: initial commit + a top-up PO once consumption metrics are validated. If Novamed prefers a single PO, Jordan can outline the billing impact.

I’ll have Jordan draft the pricing/contract notes and Priyom can coordinate the procurement portal playbook and evidence we should upload.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sow_v2.pdf (pdf), vendor_onboard_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed renewal + vendor onboarding for capacity expansion

Irene / Samantha — quick follow-up from my side.

I reviewed the requested uplift and sketched two options in the attached redlines doc (redwood_sow_v2_redlines.docx):
- Option A: 12-month term with phased capacity increase (initial commit + one scheduled top-up after month 3). Lower near-term cash outflow; slightly higher unit rate.
- Option B: 24-month term with discounted unit pricing and single PO. Better unit economics but requires longer commitment.

Procurement items we need from Novamed to start the vendor master: 
- Completed onboarding matrix (Irene’s spreadsheet)
- Vendor tax form (W-9 or equivalent)
- Supplier contact for 1099/tax (if US entity)
- Account owner to accept terms (legal or procurement rep)

Question for Novamed procurement: can you confirm whether new vendors are created in SAP with a single invoice remit, or if you require a separate remit per BU? Also, do you need our TIN/EIN on the onboarding form?

If procurement confirms the SAP workflow, Priyom and I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and pre-fill the onboarding fields to speed up portal entry.

—Jordan
Sr. Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@novamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Aug 2029 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed renewal + vendor onboarding for capacity expansion

Thanks — this is great, and apologies for the slight delay. Procurement confirmed the portal kickoff for Tue, Aug 29 at 11:00 AM PT; I’ve asked them to create the SAP vendor ticket and will attach the completed onboarding matrix to that ticket.

Attached: vendor_tax_form.pdf (we uploaded the vendor tax form to the portal and I’ve attached a copy here for your records).

Answers to Jordan's questions: 
- SAP vendor master: single vendor entry per legal entity; remit can be a single address, but we can add BU-level codes if needed.
- Yes, please include Redwood’s TIN/EIN on the onboarding form.
- Procurement prefers the phased PO approach (Option A) for now — they want to minimize forecast risk.

Irene — I’ll confirm once the portal ticket is live and share the ticket ID. If you can send the final SOW pricing by EOD Aug 29 that would keep us on the timeline.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Samantha Holt
Director, Cloud Ops
Novamed

Attachments: vendor_tax_form.pdf (pdf)
